title: Use Worker0-only stocks.json backend fetch/store flow for Add-Asset stock search (no merge/sort/chunking)

requirements.summary: Switch Add-Asset Stocks search to Worker0-only backend fetch+inspect flow and remove any merge/chunk/sort-by-marketCap behavior and copy.
acceptanceCriteria: When MarketType is Stocks, the frontend triggers the Worker0-only backend fetch (single endpoint) and then reads the stored result for parsing into searchable stock assets.
The Stocks loading UI copy no longer references merging 4 VPS endpoints and no longer implies chunked fetching.
Frontend does not merge multiple stocks sources and does not sort stock results by marketCap as part of this Worker0-only fetch path.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated React Query hook for Stocks that (1) calls the new Worker0-only backend fetch/store update method, then (2) reads the latest stored validation/inspection record via the new backend query method, and (3) parses the returned rawResponseBody into Asset[] for searching (no merging across sources).
Implement a defensive parser that converts the Worker0 stocks rawResponseBody JSON into Asset[] for MarketType.stocks without applying marketCap-based sorting and without assuming/performing merges.

Replace useStocksMergedAssets usage with the new useStocksWorker0 hook for MarketType.stocks, and update the stocks loading/error UI copy to reference a single stocks data source (remove any mention of merging 4 VPS endpoints or chunked fetching).
Remove marketCap-based sorting for MarketType.stocks in the search results path (keep existing behavior for other market types as-is, e.g., crypto if desired).
Remove the marketCap-descending sort step so this utility no longer sorts stocks by marketCap (ensuring no accidental sorting remains if this parser is still used anywhere).

Decouple Add-Asset search from the legacy 64-call merged/chunk stocks path by marking this hook as legacy/internal (or otherwise preventing it from being used by AssetSearch going forward), without introducing any new merge/chunk behavior.

Update frontend backend interface typings to match the new Worker0-only stocks fetch/store/inspect methods and the returned validation/inspection record type so the new hook can call the backend without type errors.
